source.text: All entries › Technical Debt Copy as Markdown Copied ← → Technical Debt You might say AI said to implement it this way for now and refactor later. What does that mean? The future cost left by shortcuts taken to deliver quickly, which grows the longer it stays·Taking quick shortcuts or hardcoding logic to meet tight deadlines leaves structural compromises that increase future maintenance costs. Technical debt is not an outright crash but a deliberate tradeoff; having to touch five separate files just to update one button style is the ongoing interest paid on early compromises. The longer it is deferred, the riskier and costlier refactoring becomes.
